tags-help-description: Tags be a way o' easily an' efficiently presentin' frequent information t' sailors, by usin' yer own commands.
create-success: Arr, tag created! Use {tag} t' fetch it at any time!
edit-success: Arr, tag rewritten! Use {tag} t' fetch it at any time!
delete-success: {tag} tag scrubbed! Use {commandList} t' see all yer remainin' tags!
notags-list-command: Hmmm… there be no tags. Ye can create one usin' [Quark's web dashboard]
tag-error-nocontent-1: Kindly include th' content t' be sent in th' tag
tag-error-invalidname-1: A tag by this name cannot be created
tag-error-doesnotexist-1: Kindly enter a valid tag name
tag-error-alreadyexists-1: A tag by this name already exists
tag-error-limitreached-1: This ship has reached th' limit o' 25 tags
